comparison.scope: Whole implementations on the same M1/full input. The legacy packed/narrow/four-partition body with capability-controlled I/O did not establish equivalent canonical whole-program cumulative work/memory guarantees. Its 1.3341s result is a measured baseline, not a security speed floor. Three samples per variant do not establish a statistical difference from a nearby baseline.

implementation: For a proved ASCII/no-CRLF width-one histogram with at least 1024 starts, the compiler may use four private 128-cell u64 banks. Each group updates disjoint banks; all group stores finish before the next group reads those banks. The scalar tail updates bank zero, then a bounded native reduction places exact totals in the logical 128-cell prefix.

The runtime checks the complete scratch-plus-maximum-Entry/key coexistence peak against temporary and same-account memory headroom before preferring banks. Tight headroom retains the serial native layout. This pure preference is not a permit: the actual 4096-byte capacity is reserved before allocation, and excess allocator capacity is rejected. The source owner and scratch stay live through the synchronous call; actual scratch drops before its claim.

Existing 32-per-start and 1024-per-logical-cell work bounds cover the native instructions, four zero stores and bounded reduction per cell, both materialization scans, and unchanged per-key allocation. The whole region is prepaid on the same account. No debit renewal, per-start callback, extra key materialization or limit increase.

The existing fourth private ABI word carries actual scratch extent. Only exact 512-cell width-one loans select banks; 128-cell callers use the serial body. Wider windows, empty inputs and canonical Unicode/CRLF behavior remain unchanged. The logical Map scans only the reduced prefix, never private bank contents.

One canonical artifact/catalog/compiler and one host round remain. No worker threads, new host/executor, runtime source interpreter, unsafe block, relaxed memory flags, benchmark-name/hash/alphabet specialization, ABI/IR/work-policy version change or Mech fixture edit.
